hooks.text: 每回合把一张牌加入Combo Grid，再一次性打出网格全部卡牌触发位置协同
hooks.excerpt: What makes the game unique and different from other deck-building games is the innovative Card Combo Grid which allows powerful card synergies to be built every turn. Each turn, you add a card to the combo grid and play all cards in grid. Experiment with the different card synergies and grid placement to unlock powerful effects.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战后可与怪物交朋友并招入队伍，用其特殊能力补足下场战斗
hooks.excerpt: Other than recruiting mercenaries in stores, you could also befriend monsters after combat to become your allies! Their special abilities could just be that trick up your sleeve to win the next fight.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 为不同英雄调整属性并手工制作起始牌组，再叠加等级、装备、遗物与技能路线
hooks.excerpt: The main game offers three heroes, each with their own unique style and strength. Customize the attributes of each hero and craft their starting deck to maximize their abilities. You can also level up, equip gear, find relics and learn skills to open up new roads to progression.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
